|game_text=Use 1 Force to deploy up to two clones from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. |errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Ambush (V) (Virtual Block 5)]] (version 3 of 4). The image is the Players Committee card image, which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[Ambush (V) (Virtual Block 5)]] (original, release sheet of 7 December 2009); [[Ambush (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); '''this page''' (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Ambush (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Ambush (V) (Virtual Block 5)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Use 1 Force to deploy up to two clones from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If your clones occupy three related battlegrounds during your control phase, use 2 Force (free if at Coruscant) to retrieve any one card into hand. OR If your clone in battle, add one battle destiny.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=7 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 7, slip 65. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=7 Internet Archive]</ref> The slip prints the deploy icon (▼); the wiki writes it out (“deploy … from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”), as the card list does. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Ambush (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata 3)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=32, page 32. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=32 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “65” at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Ambush (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “free if at Coruscant” to “free if on Coruscant”. PC-E1 text: “Use 1 Force to deploy up to two clones from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If your clones occupy three related battlegrounds during your control phase, use 2 Force (free if on Coruscant) to retrieve any one card into hand. OR If your clone in battle, add one battle destiny.”<ref name="cl-1250_65-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-ambush-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Ambush (V) (Virtual Block 5)]]) again, word for word: “Use 1 Force to deploy up to two clones from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If your clones occupy three related battlegrounds during your control phase, use 2 Force (free if at Coruscant) to retrieve any one card into hand. OR If your clone in battle, add one battle destiny.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual5-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual5-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034659/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “65” at the bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Ambush (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 32)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Ambush (V) (Virtual Block 5)]]) again, word for word: “Use 1 Force to deploy up to two clones from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If your clones occupy three related battlegrounds during your control phase, use 2 Force (free if at Coruscant) to retrieve any one card into hand. OR If your clone in battle, add one battle destiny.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1250-65-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “65”).
